questions.text: What is the average of all multiples of 10 from 2 to 198?
questions.solution:
Multiples of 10 between 2 and 198: 10, 20, ..., 190 (an AP).

Average = [latex]\frac{10+190}{2}=100[/latex]

Answer: 100

questions.text: Who ___________ was coming to see us this evening?
questions.solution:
Direct question: "Who did you say was coming to see us this evening?" "Did you say" is the question form, and "that" cannot follow when "who" is the subject of the clause.

Answer: did you say

questions.text:
Choose the most appropriate phrase from the options given below to complete the following sentence.

India is a post-colonial country because
questions.solution:
"Post-colonial" describes a country after colonial rule has ended. India is post-colonial because it was earlier a British colony.

Answer: it was a former British colony
